scheme_name: Distribution of Female Menstrual Hygiene Kit for the Construction Workers
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the UT
Registration fee for worker registration should not exceed ₹50
benefits_summary: Distribution of menstrual hygiene kits to registered female construction workers.
